source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Muhammed,

Thank you for your quick response. We are in the process of submitting a financial model to the government for a potential PPP project. A key requirement is to clearly demonstrate and justify the need for availability-style payments to ensure the project is viable and bankable.

I have attached the Excel template along with additional project details for your review. Please let me know if you are able to support us in developing this model. There might be some errors, please help us check it and make it look professional and clear and strong

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The presentation is not clear and i really don't understand the numbers and how they were generated....i will need something that i can understand

execution.observed_behavior: The client reports that the delivered presentation is unclear and that the model's figures and their derivation are difficult to understand.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The model is too complex, making it difficult to follow and review.
The dashboards don't clearly present the key information decision-makers need, such as project returns, debt performance, and overall bankability.
The model focuses more on calculations than telling the investment story.

I think you can add value by simplifying the model, making it easier to understand and audit, while improving the dashboards and project finance analysis. My goal would be to build a model that not only works technically but also clearly demonstrates that the project is financially viable, bankable, and attractive to investors.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Sure that's fine, we can end the contract here.

To be clear on the record the first draft was delivered on time and covered everything in the original brief. When you gave feedback that it was hard to follow, I did not ignore it I delivered a second, substantially revised version addressing that feedback directly. A simplified dashboard, clearly sourced assumptions, separated cash flows for both funding scenarios, additional financial statements, and a short summary presentation for easier review. That second deliverable was sent before you requested this refund, and I did not receive any specific review comments on it, or on the first draft, despite asking.

Given that both milestones were completed and delivered as scoped, I won't be issuing a refund. I'll be raising this through Upwork's dispute process to resolve the remaining milestone payment. You're welcome to leave whatever review you feel is accurate I'll do the same, and I'll let the delivered work and message history speak for themselves.

Happy to end this professionally on both sides.

execution.observed_behavior: The freelancer reports delivering a substantially revised second version addressing the hard-to-follow feedback, including a short summary presentation for easier review.

routing_warnings.description: The separate complaint that the dashboards do not clearly present decision metrics belongs to the Government Decision Dashboard Requirement.
The separate request for a clearer investment story belongs to the Government Investment Narrative Requirement.

The claim that figures trace to sources on the Assumptions tab primarily supports the Assumption and Source Traceability Requirement; restructuring into a simpler front page is only proposed, not claimed complete.
